title: Visiting Artist Workshop: "The Alternative Firing Experience" with Vicente Garcia
source_quote:
Visiting Artist Workshop: The Alternative Firing Experience With Vicente Garcia
March 8, 2027 @ 9:30 am - March 9, 2027 @ 5:00 pm
summary: A two-day hands-on workshop with visiting artist Vicente Garcia exploring alternative firing processes. All materials provided by Baltimore Clayworks.
evidence_sentence: The workshop teaches alternative firing processes in a hands-on two-day format with instruction on materials, applications, and firing techniques.
evidence_quote: In this hands-on workshop, participants will work with basic and advanced techniques designed to help develop skills in the application and alternative firing processes Vicente Garcia uses.
